```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 topology
title "Branch office WAN uplinks"

node access1 "Access Switch 1"
node access2 "Access Switch 2"
node branch "Branch Router"
node hubprimary "Regional Hub — Primary"
node hubbackup "Regional Hub — Backup"

link access1 branch
link access2 branch
link branch hubprimary "primary"
link branch hubbackup "backup"
```

Embed once built:

```markdown

<sub>source: [figures/branch-wan-uplinks.fd](figures/branch-wan-uplinks.fd)</sub>
```

Note on the fix: the earlier attempt put the *Markdown embed* (an image tag + `<sub>` footer) into the `.fd` file itself — that's the host document's job, not the figure source's. Line 1 of a `.fd` must be the verbatim spec comment, line 2 the `figdown 0.1 <genre>` header; nothing Markdown belongs in that file. This version puts the actual FigDown source in the `.fd` and keeps the Markdown embed separate, as the workflow section describes.
